Subject: Next steps: trial charter + propose kickoff windows

Hi Samira / Liam —

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the evaluation kickoff: 

Recap (short):
- Primary use case: triage-assist for clinic intake + structured summary (30–40% of workflows).
- Key success criteria you called out: 80% precision on triage label, <400ms 95th-token latency for short prompts, and reproducible prompt/metric baseline for QA.
- Data constraints: de-identified patient intake over SFTP for prompts + opt-in logging retention policy.

What I propose next:
1) Schedule the evaluation kickoff (60–90 min). Agenda: trial charter review, success criteria sign-off, prompt set handoff, roles + timeline.
2) Share a one-page trial charter and a short prompt pack in advance.
3) Add security/IT (for perf and data path questions) to the kickoff.

Kickoff window options (all times ET; pick 1):
- Tue, Jul 12 — 10:00–11:00 AM ET
- Wed, Jul 13 — 11:30 AM–12:30 PM ET
- Thu, Jul 14 — 2:00–3:00 PM ET

Please let me know which slot works and who from your side will join (especially security/infra). We can shift to an earlier/later time if needed.

Prework we can share: trial-charter-draft.pdf (outline of milestones & roles), sample prompt-examples.json, and a short checklist for SSO/KMS details.

If that sounds good I'll send a calendar invite and add Ben/Monica as owners for the technical and success play.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Samira / Liam —

Thanks for locking the slot. Quick technical agenda and a short prep checklist so your engineers know what to expect: 

Proposed technical deep-dive agenda (45–60 min within the kickoff):
- 5 min introductions + scope review
- 10 min trial architecture and data flow (SFTP, de-id, logging)
- 10 min model selection and performance targets (latency/throughput)
- 15 min prompt-handling and eval plan (sample prompts + grading rubric)
- 10 min Q&A and next steps (roles and timeline)

Pre-kickoff checklist for your team:
- Share SSO provider info (SAML metadata or Okta tenant)
- Confirm whether Cardwell prefers hosted API or private VPC for the eval
- If you can, attach a few representative prompts (anonymized) — I attached prompt-examples.json to this email for format reference.

I'll be on the call to run the prompt/eval segment and capture success criteria. Ben will cover rollout/ops and SLAs.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
